---
name: build
description: Implement an approved plan incrementally
---

Read the specification, architecture, task, and approved plan. Implement one small slice at a time using the existing stack (React/Vite/JavaScript; Spring Boot/Java). Preserve behavior and boundaries. Do not add dependencies or change camera/data flows without approval. Record architectural decisions in memory immediately. Add/update tests and an `[Sin publicar]` changelog entry for relevant product/code changes. Do not mark work complete before applicable validation passes.
